title: Chicken King
description: This mod adds boss: the Chicken King
body:
Chicken King – A Chicken You'd Better Not Anger
Tired of those peaceful chickens that just cluck and run away? Well, that's great, because this mod adds Chicken King – a boss who will make mincemeat of you before you can even say, "Where's he gone?"

The creature looks like a chicken, but don't be fooled – it's a pumped-up thug with skills that can wipe out half the world if he's in a bad mood.

The mod adds:
• A new boss, Chicken King, with its own attacks and mechanics
• A special weapon
